ipa.note: Unsigned sideload IPA built by the ios-ipa job. Hard budget: a PR fails when it grows more than maxGrowthPercent over the baseline. Baseline: all 28 English Kokoro voices bundled (voices-28, +11.5 MB of voice packs over the 6 of #7), measured on the integration preview IPA (run 37552906373). Change it only on purpose: node tools/budgets.ts set-ipa <bytes>, with the reason in the PR.

boot.note: Simulator cold launches in the ios-compile smoke test (boot-times.txt): median of the app's own process start to library painted. Soft budget, warning only (the CI VM is noisy). Recorded from the boot report of PR #26 (5 cold launches, macos-26).
